formation.title: Company Formation Playbook
steps: Pick the jurisdiction that fits the goal: USA (LLC for online business, Stripe/Mercury access), UK (Ltd, fast and cheap), Estonia (e-Residency, EU), Egypt (local operations, Kashier/Paymob).
Choose entity type: LLC for most online founders; C-Corp only if raising US venture money.
Order formation through a partner service; you receive incorporation documents, registered agent and EIN/tax number.
Open banking (Mercury/Wise for US, local bank for Egypt) once documents arrive.
Set up payments (Stripe needs a US/UK/EU entity; Kashier/Paymob/Fawry for Egypt).
Calendar the compliance dates: annual report, registered agent renewal, tax filings.

no-code.title: No-Code / Vibe-Coding Product Playbook
steps: Write a one-paragraph product spec: who it serves, the one job it does, the data it stores.
Build the first version in a vibe-coding platform (Lovable, Emergent, Base44 and similar) - describe screens, iterate in chat.
Connect the built-in backend (auth, database) before adding features.
Add payments only after the core loop works manually.
Publish on the platform's hosting first; move to custom hosting only when traffic justifies it.
Collect 5 real users before polishing design.

fly-hermes.title: Example Venture Playbook (travel niche)
steps: Validate the niche: pick one traveler segment and one painful problem.
Name and domain: short, pronounceable, available .com or strong TLD.
Form the legal entity only after first revenue signal; start as a landing page plus waitlist.
Build the MVP with vibe-coding tools; use travel inventory partners rather than building supply.
Monetize with partner offers first (booking, insurance, eSIM), own product later.
Track everything with a simple dashboard from day one.

freelance.title: Freelance Earning Playbook
steps: Pick one sellable skill you can deliver this week (writing, design, video editing, data entry, translation).
Create profiles on two marketplaces that match your language (Arabic: Khamsat, Kafiil; English: PeoplePerHour and similar).
Publish 3 small fixed-price services instead of one big vague one.
Deliver the first 5 orders fast and over-communicate; reviews compound.
Raise prices after 10 reviews; add AI tools to deliver faster.
Move repeat clients to a direct contract when the platform allows.

vibe-marketing.title: AI Marketing Playbook
steps: Pick one channel you can sustain (short video, SEO blog, or email).
Generate creatives with AI video/image and voice tools; keep one consistent visual style.
Publish daily for 30 days before judging results.
Reuse every piece across languages (EN + AR doubles reach).
Send traffic to one landing page, not a homepage.
Measure clicks-to-signup weekly and kill what does not convert.

ai-operations.title: Run Your Work With AI Playbook
steps: List your weekly repeated tasks; automate the top 3 first.
Use an AI assistant for drafting (emails, docs, posts) and review before sending.
Wire no-code automation between your tools (forms to sheets to email).
Keep a single source of truth for tasks and money in a management tool.
Review automations monthly; delete the ones nobody uses.
